Portrait setting: The station plaza in Musutafu on a late afternoon. Behind the character, a wide plaza of pale paving stones leads to the glass-and-steel station front, with an elevated pedestrian deck crossing above a bus roundabout; trimmed trees in round planters, bike racks and low shop fronts line the edges, and a few distant commuters appear small and blurred. No readable signs or text.

Scenery only: the choice does not move the character, grant access or affiliation, or supply props. Respect the selected frame and keep exactly one foreground character.
